lead: Add a Slate-native composition scenario family that mutates live text nodes across compositionstart/update/end and asserts model text, DOM focus node, selection offsets, and cleanup state.
evidence: CodeMirror tests cover empty lines, existing/new nodes, start/middle/end, replacement, Android-style newline, decorations, widgets, and cleanup.
decision: Defer the full live-node mutation matrix until a concrete failing route or accepted real-composition-span policy exists; keep current richtext IME coverage for private-alpha claim width.
verification: P60 focused IME coverage passed 11 Chromium rows and 2 WebKit cleanup rows; P86 records real composition-span overlap as policy-owned.

lead: Add controlled paste helpers that exercise Slate paste logic with `text/plain`, `text/html`, and browser-like DataTransfer payloads without relying on clipboard permissions.
evidence: ProseMirror exposes `pasteHTML`/`pasteText`; Lexical tests `DataTransferMock` rich paste and iOS prediction plaintext-vs-HTML equality.
decision: Promoted/kept: `slate-browser` exposes paste helpers and `slate-dom` clipboard contracts exercise DataTransfer-style rich/plain payloads.
verification: Focused `packages/slate-dom` clipboard-boundary run passed 15 rows; route helpers expose `pasteText`, `pasteNativeText`, `pasteEventPayload`, and rich clipboard payload helpers.

lead: Keep or add tests proving temporary native selection moves during copy/projected selection/hidden content do not corrupt model selection.
evidence: ProseMirror suppresses selection updates in sensitive windows and copy capture blurs/moves native selection before restoring focus.
decision: Promoted/kept: focused browser proof covers selectionchange noise, hidden-content copy while DOM is absent, and repair-kernel selectionchange state.

lead: Add command-boundary browser rows around editable voids/contenteditable=false blocks: insert before/after, ranged selection crossing boundary, no-op in noneditable root, follow-up typing/cursor placement.
evidence: Command-boundary pressure points to cursor placement and content after commands near noneditable blocks and noneditable roots.
decision: Kept existing route proof around editable voids/contenteditable=false-adjacent command boundaries.
verification: Focused Chromium proof bundle passed editable-void selectionchange, boundary movement, cross-boundary selection, paste, and parent-selection rows.

lead: Keep feature-specific table clipboard invariants in table-fragment semantics, but do not mix them with generic selection/IME proof.
evidence: Table clipboard behavior belongs to feature-specific geometry and replacement logic, not generic text input.
decision: Keep as table lane follow-up, not immediate generic runtime patch.
verification: Existing table fragment docs already own this lane.
